title: [Stress fracture of athletes as a cause of groin pain].

sections.label: CLINICAL/METHODICAL ISSUE
sections.text: In this article, suitable imaging of stress reactions and stress fractures in athletes will be examined.

sections.label: STANDARD RADIOLOGICAL METHODS
sections.text: Diagnostic procedures include X‑ray, computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), and bone scintigraphy.

sections.label: METHODICAL INNOVATIONS
sections.text: MRI represents the gold standard for these types of injuries.

sections.label: PERFORMANCE
sections.text: Of all imaging techniques, MRI shows the highest sensitivity in terms of diagnostic and prognostic aspects in stress reactions and stress fractures.

sections.label: PRACTICAL RECOMMENDATIONS
sections.text: Early performance of MRI to evaluate the staging, therapy and prognosis of the healing process is recommended.
